description: A bright surgical-white preparation room organized around sterile instrument layout. Stainless-steel trays and small instruments are arranged only on cart and tray surfaces, with sterilizing equipment along the back wall. A surgeon and scrub nurse perform final pre-op checks beside a central wheeled surgery cart.

layout_goals.focal_point: central sterile surgery cart with instrument tray and highlighted Forceps_01 interaction target

steps.action: Establish the sterile room shell, clear central circulation, and bright surgical lighting zone.
steps.target_area: ceiling center and upper side walls
steps.condition: Keep the floor open around the central prep cart; lighting should read bright, cool, and clinical.

steps.action: Place sterilizing equipment in an organized back-wall line for autoclave and sterilizer interactions.
steps.target_area: back wall, z near maximum, evenly spaced left to right
steps.condition: All sterilizing equipment must sit against the wall with front access facing the room and no instruments placed on the floor nearby.

steps.action: Create the central sterile field with a wheeled surgery cart and tray surface for story-critical instruments.
steps.target_area: center of room, slightly forward of back-wall sterilizers
steps.condition: Tray_01 rests on top of Surgery_Cart_01; Forceps_01, Scalpel_01, Syringe_01, and Scissors_01 are precisely aligned on Tray_01, never on the floor.

steps.action: Add secondary supply carts with additional sterile trays and backup instruments to reinforce meticulous organization.
steps.target_area: left and right side walls with carts angled toward the central sterile field
steps.condition: All small instruments must be placed on cart tops or tray surfaces; preserve clear walking space between carts and the central cart.

steps.action: Add scrub-prep and sanitation support items near the entry side without cluttering the sterile instrument field.
steps.target_area: front-left and front-right wall zones near doorway
steps.condition: Sanitation props may rest on Sink_01 or cart surfaces; Trash_Biohazard_01 stays tucked against a wall and away from the central sterile tray.

steps.action: Place the surgeon and scrub nurse in final pre-op check positions oriented toward the central cart.
steps.target_area: around central Surgery_Cart_01, surgeon on one side and nurse on the opposite side
steps.condition: Characters should face the central instrument tray; keep enough space for the nurse to walk toward Forceps_01 during the interaction arc.

steps.action: Define interaction targets and highlight sequence for the short story arc.
steps.target_area: central cart and back-wall sterilizer line
steps.condition: Touching Surgeon_01 triggers a request for Forceps_01 and highlights Forceps_01 yellow; touching Forceps_01 makes Nurse_01 walk to the central cart and acknowledge; touching Tray_01 afterward brightens surgical lighting and makes the surgeon nod ready to begin. Touching Autoclave_01 or Sterilizer_Drum_01 triggers sterilization-status dialogue.
